answer: The ivory schedule is applied in ember and sparrow exposes each instalment. A payout is split so that 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 7 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2968 identities would post 640 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
